problem: Real VNC input wraps Cyrillic letters in ISO_Level3_Shift press/release. Alt completion preparation and the paired used-as-modifier release invalidate the owned word's Space worker despite no client text edit. The retained input-frame value alone does not detect that its worker lease was destroyed.
reason: A pure modifier edge does not edit the word; retiring its existing worker lease loses an admitted correction before the following Space.
decision: Keep an admitted word across pure Alt/level-modifier preparation and its paired used-as-modifier release. Preserve existing Shift+Alt, unhandled client-key, standalone failed completion, unpaired release, focus, layout and admission revocation. No candidate, rank, output executor, timer, privacy exception or gesture owner changes.

alternatives.option: Preserve the exact lease across zero-text modifier edges
Add a VNC-specific retry or wait

verification: Wire capture plus a regression asserting the worker lease, exact correction surface and absence of surrounding deletion. Existing standalone failed-Alt and confirmed-reset completion controls remain mandatory. Actual native acceptance must use installed bytes separately.
not_tested: Other remote transports and future client bytes are not established by the retained source and native receipts.
